monsterDescriptions.text: Long ago a wizard's experiment had gone afoul and this is the result.
Though they are not difficult to kill, take care.  Their bite is most poisonous.
A strange cross between an ogre and a dwarf.  These creatures were born of magic long ago.
A powerful leader in the Abyss.  Arch rival of Huntoo (Earl of the Undead).
Not a true dragon.  Named after there ilk for it is the only beast known that can rival them in brute strength.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into for no one has ever found one in a cocoon state.
Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes their entire lives to the destruction of their evil kin.
A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to  avoid.
Sickly in appearance, these foul creatures blend into their  surroundings and pounce on the unsuspecting.
A truly fearsome arachnid.  Avoid contact with this eight legged monstrosity, if at all possible.
Created from nonliving parts and given life through arcane magic.  They will serve their creator until destroyed.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.  These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerful creatures love to engage in combat.
A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
Often used to guard magical treasure or some important location.
Earl of the Undead, Huntoo is a powerful ruler in the Abyss and arch rival of Lord Pusswart.
A mountainous man-fish.
Though they look fierce, they are not as deadly as one might think.
Large and deadly.  Their saliva contains a strange chemical.  Those that do not save will become deathly afraid.
An odd sight, indeed.  Their appearance would be laughable, if they were not so deadly.  They favor the occasional orc to dine on.
A strange cross between a hyena and a tiger.  Nobody knows if it was spawned from magic or nature.
Little can stand in the way of a rampaging titan.  These huge folk have little trouble with the evil vulk of the Abyss.
Large, but stupid.  These reptiles have been known to trample an adult ogre without even slowing down.
Do not get too close!  If it gets you in a bear hug you are doomed for sure.
Common in some areas of the Abyss that have a cold climate.  No dragon in the Realmz can match this breed when it comes to having a heart of pure evil.
Formed from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.
A real monster.  Fortunately, this eight-legged monstrosity has NO venom.
A huge animal with tusks as long as most men are tall.  Stand aside!   Do not block the path of a rampaging behemoth.
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  Their bite has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
Sporting a nasty bite, these critters are more dangerous than they look.
Little is known about the greckle for they are solitary creatures that dabble in the black arts.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
Long ago, a tribe of trolls developed the ability to think.  Since then, they have developed a strong tribal society that rivals orcs and goblins.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few  have met with one and LIVED!
Woe to the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one such as this.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
Half tiger, half humanoid.  This delightful race relishes all that is good in life.  How ironic that they are only found in the Abyss.
Old crypts are the favorite haunt of these foul vermin.  Though named as a troll, these creatures are no relation to true trolls.
A magical being summoned by the hand of a mighty wizard.  Once summoned, they will carry out their master's will until destroyed.
Created eons ago as punishment by the gods, this foul race is feared by even the most evil and powerful wizards that walk the Realmz.
An evil experiment of some mad devil gone awry.  Part green dragon, part gargoyle, all bad temper.
A snake of unbelievable size.  Easily  60 feet in length and as large around as a full-grown bull vusk.
Large and heavily armored, with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.
A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the queen.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with  keeping the troops in line and being loyal to the queen.
In life, a formerly valiant warrior. In death, he is now a cursed pawn of evil.
Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
A strong family structure allows these giant reptiles to survive in a hostile environment.
Capable of traveling through earth as you or I through air.  You may never be prepared for these creatures, since they attack from below.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts would make excellent warriors if they were not so lazy.
Neither fast nor powerful, these nasty reptiles do have one advantage - a poisonous bite.
Hailing from some unknown plane, these beasts are often summoned by powerful enchanters to perform their bidding.
Though not native to the Abyss, they populate large regions of that foul area.
The creature's favorite form of attack is to lower its armored head and charge.  Don't stand in front of it!
This most beguiling of devils preys on the sexual impulses of mortals.  Taking the shape of a beautiful man or woman, they lure unsuspecting souls to their doom.
These minor demons live their lives as servants to those more powerful than themselves.
Large and fierce, this race of half ogre, half dwarf is feared thoughout the land.
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your life force.
These creatures are almost indestructible.
Born of pure evil.  These beautiful, deadly creatures love to inhabit murky forests.
Large and fierce, this race of beings is known to only exist on the planes of the Abyss.
A close cousin to the red dragon.  These creatures are more common in the Abyss than on the material plane.
Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn they can also split in two when destroyed.
Capable of inflicting a strong chemical burn they can also split in two when destroyed.
A creature of the undead.  Their bite can cause disease.  They are also capable of regenerationg so it's best to kill them quickly.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
A member of a cult of dwarves. They wish to bring about the union of the Realmz and the Abyss.
A small reptilian creature that is extremely ferocious.  They are often used as fodder in wars between demon lords.  They are not of demonic descent.
Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by   other demons.
One of the Hemerood.  God-like in power.  This evil race is making its way back to the known Realmz for the first time in 50 millenia.
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
Slightly larger and more powerful than goblins, these close cousins to true goblins band together in large tribes.
Living on the frigid planes of the Abyss, this vile race will attack any goodly race on sight.
A minotaur adventurer who is willing to put up with your company.  He knows that danger follows you and wishes to get in on the action.
A brave but somewhat unskilled troop.
A conscript with little to look forward to in the civilian world.  For this reason they often reenlist to become corporals.
Charged to keep the troops in line.
A true leader of men.
Skilled in the ways of combat and leadership.  An up and coming officer.
A skilled warrior of the dwarven nations.
A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these netherworld creatures is without compare.
Normally, they feed on only the dead.  In times of hunger, they will often hunt their prey.
Abused as a youngster.  These ill- tempered men are common thugs for hire.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
Beaten when young, these evil people make a poor choice of company.
They travel in large packs to avoid falling prey to more powerful demons.
Often found in large packs, these small but powerful demons should be avoided.
Avoid the paralyzing bite of these large insects.
Half man.  Half fish.  All bad temper.
A small, but deadly variety of your every day troll.
Capable of casting clerical spells. This humanoid should be feared.
Prefers to feed on the dead.  However, they will not hesitate to add a little fresh meat when it's available.
Belonging to the arachnid family, these large critters pack a paralyzing sting.
A warrior of great skill and strength.
The priest of a tribe of orcs.
Strong and capable with arms.
Only slightly less primitive than a cave man.  These humanoids are all but animals.
Ratius Giantous
Skilled in the use of a bow.  These warriors prefer to pepper their enemies with fine yew wood shafts.
A paralyzing sting makes this large insect quite deadly.
Over two feet of mindless insect. Capable of overwhelming foes by their sheer numbers.
Large and fierce warriors of above average skill.
A hob goblin skilled in the use of a bow.
A worm the size of which even the gods have never seen.  A true freak of nauture.
They stand 16 feet at the shoulder. These gargantuan humanoids have grown civil enough to live in harmony with humans, elves, and other more civilized races.
An underground dweller that is more reptile than man.  They hate all surface dwellers.
A larger version of the worker ant. Bred to do battle and defend the nest.
The central brains behind an ant colony.  Her death is the death of the colony.
Resembling ghouls, these vile creatures often live among their lesser cousins.
Skilled in the ways of thievery as well as war.  These vile thugs would just as soon slit your throat as look at you.
With a shell as dark as soot, this crab is a mindless eating machine with powerful pincers.
With a hard carapace as tough as steel plating, this crab is like a knight in armor.
Large glands in the pincers inject victims with a powerful chemical that bursts into flame when it comes in contact with air.
Thousands of tiny spots give this crab its name.  Though nowhere near as fast as a leopard, it is just as deadly.
A powerful warrior who has been polymorphed into a goblin.
Pawns of the frost giants.  These weak-minded fools often do the bidding of the giants and fight by their side.
A hideous being which feeds on the mental energy of its victims.  Once the mental energy is drained, it feeds on the actual physical brain.
A race of giants that was trapped in the Abyss during the great upheaval.  They are one of the few good races that calls the Abyss home.
A rothian giant guide.  He smells of strong wine and moldy leather.  He is well-known for his cowardly ways.
Loners in the world of the Abyss.  They are among the rarest of demons.  It is rumored that only a few clans of these demons still survive.
The name is only part of the story.  These foul-tempered creatures stink to high heaven and have a face no mother could love.
Souls that have been damned to roam the astral plane.  If provoked, they can exist on the material plane for short periods.
Often found in the company of ghouls, ghasts and other ilk of that manner.  These fiends have an endless appetite for flesh, either alive or dead.
They are extremely rare even on their own plane of existence.  The shadow mite is immune to projectile weapons.
The black sheep of the Abyss.  Half demon, half devil.  They are often shunned by full-blooded demons and devils.
A mutated mushman, fungoids are extremely rare... and deadly.
These malevelent creatures are immune to cold based spells.  They also have a nasty bite.
These beasts are no more than slaves to the evil eys.  They serve as hands for those that have none.  They are imensly strong.
Weak in mind and body, these demons are lightning quick.  They are cowards in battle and will surrender or run easily.
Incredibly strong, these demons rule over whole races of lesser ilk.  They prefer to pummle their enemies with bare hands and magic.
Existing on both the material plane and the astral plane simultaneously.  They can inflict massive chemical damage.
Nomally happy to stand around and chew cud.  These creatures can be dangerous if they stampede.
These vermin carry a deadly disease.  They breed so rapidly there are always plenty to take the place of those that perish.
Arch rival of the Black Knight, he is in eternal search for his nemesis.  Each has sworn to slay the other in a blood oath that has lasted for years.
